# Interoperability fixtures

These small archives contain only synthetic files. The TAR archives use
`README.txt` and `folder/notes.txt`; the ZIP uses `README.txt` and the UTF-8 name
`folder/café.txt`. They were generated by the real `bsdtar` archive writer;
[`manifest.json`](manifest.json) records the producer version and each archive's
SHA-256 digest.

Regenerate them with `python tools/generate_interop_fixtures.py` from the
repository root. The generator requires a `bsdtar` executable on `PATH`, stores
archive members using relative POSIX paths, and fixes timestamps and TAR
ownership to neutral values. It does not read user files or extract archives.
The manifest checksums identify these checked-in binaries; compressed bytes can
change when the producer or its compression libraries change.

The `gnu/` directory contains a separate uncompressed USTAR fixture created by
GNU tar 1.35. Regenerate it with `python tools/generate_interop_fixtures.py --producer gnu`;
GNU tar is found on `PATH` or beside Git for Windows. Its manifest records the
neutral numeric and named ownership fields used for the archive.
